component.name: Miku Home
component.summary: Accessible voice assistant that runs on your device

description.p: Miku Home is a free, open-source voice assistant built for blind and low-vision people and for people whose speech is hard for other assistants to understand.

ul.li: Speak or type. Every reply is shown as a caption and announced to screen readers.
Speech is recognised on your computer. Nothing is sent to any server.
Works fully offline, with no account, no analytics and no ads.
High-contrast, keyboard-first design tested with Orca.

screenshot.caption: Typing say hi gets a captioned reply

description.p: First beta: standalone mode with on-device speech recognition, captions and a privacy page.
